facts.fact: NewZimbabwe reports that two women were charged under Section 164B of the Criminal Law (Codification and Reform) Act for allegedly circulating AI-generated images and videos of a businessman with South Africa's president, were held in custody for three to four nights, and the complainant withdrew the charges in court on 22 May 2026.
